quarterly_data.quarter: Pfizer press release: Pfizer's Tilrekimig Shows Significant Skin Clearance in (10-01-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Detailed Phase 2 results (EADV 2026) for tilrekimig (PF-07275315), a trispecific IL-4 / IL-13 / TSLP antibody, in moderate-to-severe atopic dermatitis: EASI-75 at Week 16 was 62.5% with 450 mg Q2W versus 19.9% on placebo (p=0.0008) in Stage 1, and 58.5%, 61.0% and 47.8% with 400 mg, 200 mg and 50 mg Q4W versus 9.1% in Stage 2 (all p<0.003); vIGA 0/1 was 30.3% versus 11.8% (Stage 1) and 26%-27% versus 0% (Stage 2), with no serious adverse events related to tilrekimig. Patients have been dosed in three Phase 3 studies (two in atopic dermatitis, one against dupilumab, and one in asthma) and a Phase 2b/3 study in COPD is ongoing. Chief Inflammation & Immunology Officer Michael Vincent: tilrekimig has the potential to raise the bar beyond current standard-of-care biologics.
